battle.name: 赤瓜礁海戰
battle.brief: 赤瓜礁海戰於一九八八年三月二十三日爆發，是中越兩國軍隊在南海赤瓜礁及鄰近海域的武裝衝突，也是參考清單收錄的衝突。中國海軍艦艇執行海上巡邏與警戒，中國空軍則出動J-8 II（殲八II）戰鬥機，承擔制空、攔截及海上支援任務。

kit.name: 殲八II戰鬥機
kit.history: J-8 II是中國人民解放軍空軍的單座全天候截擊機，編入航空兵師下屬殲擊機團，主要執行高空高速攔截、警戒與制空任務。

countries: 1988年5月3日，赤瓜礁海戰發生在南海斯普拉特利群島西南部，英文史料常以 Johnson South Reef 指稱同一地點。中方由人民解放軍海軍南海艦隊的驅逐艦、護衛艦與兩棲運輸兵力組成艦艇編隊；越方由越南人民海軍第二海區的HQ-10系列導彈艇、運輸船及礁上駐軍執行巡邏與輪換。兩國都主張群島主權，現場則是海軍艦艇和登陸兵力直接對抗。戰鬥從命令、警告與航路封鎖發展成艦炮交火，最後轉為中方登陸、奪取礁面控制。從開始到結束，中方保持海上火力掩護，越方以艇隊遮護運輸船並組織撤退。本文只把兩國公開資料中可以互相核對的事實合併陳述，不把任何一方的單方說法當成未經證實的定論。
countriesEn: The Battle of Chigua Reef took place on 3 May 1988 in the southwestern portion of the Spratly Islands in the South China Sea, the same location often identified in English-language records as Johnson South Reef. The Chinese side formed a naval group from the South Sea Fleet consisting of destroyers, frigates, and amphibious transport forces, while the Vietnamese side deployed HQ-10-series missile boats, transport vessels, and a reef garrison from the Second Naval Region of the Vietnam People’s Navy for patrols and personnel rotations. Both countries claimed sovereignty over the islands, but the immediate clash was between naval vessels and amphibious forces. The action developed from orders, warnings, and attempts to control the sea route into a naval gunnery engagement, before shifting to a Chinese landing operation that secured the reef. Throughout the action, Chinese ships maintained covering fire at sea, while Vietnamese boats screened the transports and organized their withdrawal. This account combines facts that can be compared across both countries’ public records and does not present either side’s unilateral account as an unverified final judgment.
people: 中方公開資料通常把南海艦隊司令詹榮喧列為作戰海域的最高主官，並記載張仁勇負責艦艇編隊的具體指揮。這次行動不是由單艦自行決定，驅逐艦、護衛艦、登陸運輸艦與海上指揮所均依照艦隊命令協同。502艦是接觸越方艇隊的主要前衛艦；越方第二海區由岸上機關向海上分隊下达命令，HQ-10導彈艇負責警戒和遮護，運輸船負責把輪換人員送上礁。越方公開材料沒有提供一個能在雙方紀錄中一致核對的戰鬥指揮姓名。戰中雙方均有艇員或士兵死亡、受傷，越方還有人被俘；各方公布的傷亡總數彼此衝突，故不列任何精確總數，也不把單方名單視為完整傷亡表。
peopleEn: Chinese public records generally identify South Sea Fleet commander Zhan Rongxuan as the senior commander responsible for the operational area and credit Zhang Renyong with the direct command of the ship group. The operation was not decided by an individual vessel: destroyers, frigates, amphibious transports, and the maritime command post acted together under fleet orders. Ship 502 was the principal frigate that made contact with the Vietnamese boats. On the Vietnamese side, shore authorities in the Second Naval Region issued orders to the maritime detachment, with HQ-10 missile boats providing warning, screening, and covering fire while transports carried rotation personnel to the reef. Vietnamese public accounts do not provide a combat commander’s name that can be consistently verified against the opposing record. Personnel from both sides were killed or wounded, and some Vietnamese personnel were captured. Because the published casualty totals conflict with one another, no exact overall figure is given, and no unilateral list is treated as a complete casualty record.
kits: 中方可核對的核心裝備包括105艦衡陽號051型驅逐艦與502艦通化號053H1型護衛艦。衡陽艦位於編隊外圈，負責較大範圍的海上警戒；通化艦裝有100毫米艦炮、57毫米艦炮與30毫米機炮，公開戰鬥記錄能確認502艦曾以100毫米艦炮攻擊越方艇船。越方可核對的裝備主要是502號與503號HQ-10系列小型導彈艇，通常歸入Project 622M型譜系，配備P-15反艦導彈與AK-230型30毫米自動炮，另有運輸艇和登陸艇承載輪換兵力。P-15是否實際發射以及命中情形，在雙方紀錄中沒有完整證據，不能補寫發射數或命中數；100毫米炮彈則確實用於此次交火。
kitsEn: The principal Chinese equipment that can be verified consists of destroyer Hengyang, hull 105, a Type 051 destroyer, and frigate Tonghua, hull 502, a Type 053H1 frigate. Hengyang operated on the outer edge of the formation and provided wider-area maritime security, while Tonghua carried 100 mm naval guns, 57 mm naval guns, and 30 mm automatic cannon. The surviving combat records confirm that ship 502 used its 100 mm guns against Vietnamese vessels. The principal verifiable Vietnamese weapons included small missile boats numbered 502 and 503 of the HQ-10 series, commonly associated with the Project 622M family. They carried P-15 anti-ship missiles and AK-230 30 mm automatic cannon, while transports and landing craft carried the rotating personnel. There is no complete evidence across the two sides’ records confirming whether P-15 missiles were launched or whether any hit, so no launch count or hit count has been supplied. The 100 mm naval gun ammunition was definitely used in the engagement.
tactics: 中方編隊採取分層部署，驅逐艦留在外圈觀察航道，護衛艦向前接近，登陸與運輸兵力則在後方保持可轉入登陸的位置。502艦先行接近越方運輸編隊，透過航行位置與通訊要求對方離開相關海峽；越方HQ-10艇則以艇身遮護運輸船，使部分船艇得以靠近礁緣。當双方 maneuvering space 收縮、命令與退出行動未能完成時，100毫米艦炮首先造成一艘越方艇船起火並失去繼續航行能力，越方其他艇船隨即以機炮及反艦武器方向实施還擊。中方沒有讓前衛艦孤立地追越，而是維持舰炮与运输兵力之间的掩护关系。越方受损艇无法继续接应，越军海上编队撤离后，中方将两栖兵力转入小艇分批送上礁面，越方守军的组织抵抗随之停止，整个行动由海战转为占领与控制。
tacticsEn: The Chinese formation used a layered deployment. Destroyers remained on the outer perimeter to monitor the sea lane, frigates moved forward, and the amphibious and transport forces stayed behind in positions from which they could begin a landing. Ship 502 approached the Vietnamese transport group first, using its position and communications to require the Vietnamese vessels to leave the relevant passage. The Vietnamese HQ-10 boats screened the transports and allowed some vessels to approach the edge of the reef. When maneuvering room contracted and neither side completed its withdrawal, 100 mm naval gunfire set one Vietnamese vessel ablaze and deprived it of the ability to continue underway. The remaining Vietnamese boats then attempted to retaliate with automatic cannon and anti-ship weapons. The Chinese did not allow the leading frigate to pursue alone but maintained the relationship between gun cover and the transport forces. The damaged Vietnamese boat could no longer provide support, and after the Vietnamese maritime group withdrew, Chinese amphibious personnel were transferred into small boats and landed in successive groups. Organized resistance by the Vietnamese garrison then ended, changing the action from a naval engagement into occupation and control of the reef.
data: 3月下旬起，中方南海艦隊開始為南沙行動集中艦艇與登陸兵力。艦隊由南海艦隊基地出航，航向先朝東南，經西沙群島海域轉入南沙，公開戰史多把永興島一帶視為途中補給、檢查與重新編隊的節點。母艦隨編隊攜帶柴油、淡水、口糧與艦炮及機炮彈藥，實際登陸兵力則由後方運輸艦送入小型登陸艇。5月3日上午十時過後，赤瓜礁外海形成接觸；中方戰報把第一次100毫米炮擊記為約10時14分，越方紀錄則對此前命令與射擊次序另有排列。可以確定的是，艦炮交火集中在上午十時後的數十分鐘內，其後才轉為登陸與鞏固。公開資料不足以核實總炮數、導彈發射數、各艇距離與完整後勤消耗，因此這些數字不作推測。
dataEn: From late March, the Chinese South Sea Fleet began concentrating ships and amphibious forces for operations in the Spratlys. The group departed from bases of the fleet, initially sailed southeast, passed through the Xisha Islands area, and then entered the Spratlys. Public campaign histories generally treat the Yongxing Island area as a point for replenishment, inspection, and reorganization during the passage. The support ships traveled with the formation and carried diesel fuel, fresh water, rations, and naval-gun and automatic-cannon ammunition, while the actual landing force was transferred from transports farther back into small landing craft. Contact was made outside Chigua Reef shortly after 10 a.m. on 3 May. Chinese battle reports time the first 100 mm salvo at approximately 10:14, whereas Vietnamese records arrange the earlier orders and firing sequence differently. What can be established is that the gunnery exchange occurred within several tens of minutes after 10 a.m. and was followed by the landing and consolidation phase. The public evidence is insufficient to verify the total number of shells, missile launches, vessel distances, or complete logistical expenditure, so those figures are not estimated.
cause: 赤瓜礁衝突是南海主權爭端長期累積後的近距離碰撞，而不是一次無關的偶發炮擊。中方依據對南海島礁及歷史文獻的解讀主張主權，越方則依據對法屬印度支那時期治理的承接及實際駐防主張權利；兩種法律與歷史依據直到1988年仍未由共同接受的裁判解決。1979年邊境戰爭後，南海艦隊活動與越方巡邏都更為頻繁。1988年3月以後，中方希望在所主張控制的島礁維持或擴大海上駐軍，越方則繼續對現有礁點執行補給與人員輪換。5月3日，兩支任務在赤瓜礁外海相遇；中方把越方接近視為妨礙登陸與航路控制，越方則把中方要求退出視為改變既有控制，因而都以海上兵力維護各自行動。
causeEn: The clash at Chigua Reef was the result of long-running sovereignty disputes in the South China Sea converging at close range, rather than an unrelated accidental exchange of fire. China based its claim on its interpretation of the maritime islands and historical documents, while Vietnam relied on its succession to the former French administration of Indochina and its actual garrison presence. Those historical and legal positions had not been resolved through a mutually accepted adjudication by 1988. After the border conflict of 1979, South Sea Fleet activity and Vietnamese patrols both became more frequent. From March 1988 onward, China sought to maintain or expand a maritime presence on reefs it claimed, while Vietnam continued resupplying existing positions and rotating personnel. The two missions converged outside Chigua Reef on 3 May. China regarded the Vietnamese approach as an attempt to obstruct its landing and control of the sea route, while Vietnam regarded the Chinese demand for withdrawal as an attempt to overturn existing control. Each therefore used naval forces to protect its own operation.
impact: 這次戰鬥最直接的結果，是赤瓜礁的實際控制轉入中方手中。中方登陸兵力在艦隊掩護下完成進駐，越方原有的海上接應中斷，至少一艘HQ-10導彈艇重損後被放棄，其餘艇船撤離；502艦亦受到炮彈破片影響並有人員傷亡，但公開資料無法核實完整損壞程度與傷亡總數。越方沒有在此次行動中立即重奪該礁，但繼續維持南沙其他島礁的駐防與巡邏；中方則把赤瓜礁納入後續巡邏、補給與常態駐守。這場戰鬥改變的是一個礁點的實際控制及周邊兵力部署，沒有代替國際法律程序，也不代表斯普拉特利群島整體主權問題已獲解決。雙方之後仍透過外交交涉相互指責，軍事上的近距離對峙也隨之增加。
impactEn: The most direct effect of the battle was that actual control of Chigua Reef passed to China. Chinese landing forces established a garrison under naval cover, severing the existing Vietnamese maritime link. At least one HQ-10 missile boat was heavily damaged and abandoned, while the remaining boats withdrew. Ship 502 also suffered splinter damage and personnel casualties, although the public evidence does not establish its complete damage or an exact casualty total. Vietnam did not immediately retake the reef during this action, but it continued to garrison and patrol other positions in the Spratlys. China incorporated Chigua Reef into its subsequent patrols, replenishment system, and permanent military presence. The battle changed de facto control of one reef and the deployment of forces around it; it did not replace an international legal process or settle sovereignty over the Spratlys as a whole. Both governments continued to protest the other’s conduct through diplomatic channels, and close military confrontation around the area subsequently increased.
result: 艦炮交火停止後，尚能航行的越方艇船退出赤瓜礁外海，重損艇失去接應與撤退能力；中方隨即完成登陸，越方守軍未能重新登船，現場出現中方俘獲的越方軍人。此後中方在該礁維持駐軍，越方在此次戰鬥尾聲沒有奪回控制，但雙方都沒有公開一份可由第三方核對的完整戰損、俘虜與傷亡紀錄。首次開火者仍有爭議：中方記錄把第一輪100毫米炮擊放在越方拒絕退出之後，越方則認為更早的驅離與航路控制已構成挑釁。從可確認的物質結果看，赤瓜礁由中方控制，至少一艘越方導彈艇被放棄，越方輪換行動失敗；從法律結果看，主權爭端並未因戰鬥而解決，戰役因此應以實際奪礁與後續控制變化記錄，而不能只引用任何一方單方面的勝負名稱。
resultEn: After the naval gunnery ceased, the Vietnamese vessels that remained seaworthy withdrew from the waters outside Chigua Reef, while the heavily damaged boat lost both support and the ability to withdraw. Chinese forces then completed their landing. The Vietnamese garrison was unable to re-embark, and Chinese forces captured Vietnamese soldiers present at the site. China subsequently maintained a garrison on the reef, and Vietnam did not regain control during the closing phase of this action. Neither government, however, published a complete and independently verifiable record of damage, prisoners, and casualties that a third party could cross-check. Responsibility for the first shot remains disputed: Chinese records place the first 100 mm salvo after the Vietnamese vessels refused to withdraw, while Vietnam regarded the earlier attempt to remove them and control the sea route as a provocation. In terms of the material outcome, China controlled Chigua Reef, at least one Vietnamese missile boat was abandoned, and the Vietnamese rotation mission failed. In legal terms, the sovereignty dispute was not resolved by the battle. The engagement should therefore be recorded through the physical seizure of the reef and the resulting change in control, rather than through either side’s unilateral victory label alone.
